protected_behaviors.description: Existing saved items survive a restart without content changes.

journeys.goal: Save a new item and find it after reopening.
journeys.initial_state: Original saved item exists; candidate app is open.
steps: Create a new item with distinctive content.
Restart the app and open the saved item.
expected: New item contains the exact entered content.

journeys.goal: Correct invalid input without losing other draft content.
journeys.initial_state: Draft has a valid description and an invalid required field.
expected: Description is preserved and only one final item is stored.

journeys.goal: Open different items repeatedly without selecting the wrong item.
journeys.initial_state: At least three saved items with different content exist.
steps: Edit item two, reopen it, then inspect item three.
expected: Every open matches the selected stable item identity.
Editing item two never changes item three.
